name: beacon
description: BEACON — Emergency Communication & Incident War Room Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace database
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace database
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace frontend && npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace database
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace database && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
